title: Teaching Children the Adab of Eating from the Prophetic Sunnah

text_simplified: Parents must teach their children the *adab* of eating and drinking, such as eating with the right hand and saying *bismillah* before starting. They should also accustom them to patience and avoiding extravagance in food. The Prophetic story illustrates the importance of *tarbiyah* (upbringing) in good conduct from a young age.
